title: Jantei Battle Cos-Player: Original Gengashuu
native_title: 雀帝バトル・コスプレイヤー オリジナル原画集
overview:
Jantei Battle Cos-Player: Original Gengashuu is a not-for-sale promotional disc from Daiki for its mahjong game Jantei Battle Cos-Player. As its title says, it is a collection of the game's original artwork.

Jantei Battle Cos-Player is set in a distant future ruled by wealthy women, where one-of-a-kind handmade costumes are the ultimate status symbol. As Yuko Saionji, heiress to the Saionji conglomerate, you play four-player riichi mahjong against live-action and animated opponents in a tournament and win their costumes as prizes.
